headline: Sunday night in Cleveland: the one test this defense should pass.
lede: The Browns are 6-4 and score 18.8 points a game (27th). The Raiders allow 29.7 (32nd). Last game before the bye.

pick.text: Browns by three. The Raiders' defense has allowed 30 or more in seven of eight games, and a rookie sacked 11 times in two starts goes on the road at night.

keys.title: Hold them under 20
keys.text: Cleveland scores 18.8 a game, 27th. The Raiders haven't held anyone under 20 since Week 2. Do it and they win.

keys.title: Keep Mendoza clean
keys.text: Eleven sacks in two starts. Three or fewer on Sunday is the number to watch.

keys.title: Run, even badly
keys.text: 77.3 rushing yards a game, 31st. Twenty-five carries slows the rush whatever the average.
